end.summary:
Distinguished observation, hypothesis, law and theory in three unaided examples.
Used butterfly flight and salt-water boiling point to discuss hypotheses and measurement.
Explained that a scientific theory explains tested evidence, unlike an everyday guess.
The idea that theories turn into laws remained uncorrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting observations, hypotheses, laws and theories using butterfly flight and boiling-point examples. Tara used measurement language such as thermometer, temperature and boiling point, and explained that a scientific theory gives an evidence-based explanation rather than being an everyday guess. Tara still mixed up theories and laws, so this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Tara to sort a few examples into observation, hypothesis, law or theory and explain why a theory does not turn into a law.
